film.inputs: product name, URL, 4–6 features, brand colors
film.direction: One shape, never cut. A cursor drives every change with real clicks. Last frame equals first (loops).
film.rules: Closed-form springs only; every size/radius/color uses track(); cuts on beats; type uses heavy preset.
film.gotchas: Text must not reflow mid-morph; clip children to the shape; cursor arrives 1 beat before each click.
